_note: Plan 100033: four mutants, one per branch of the manifest-provenance gate. A survivor is a missing test, stated as Critical. 0 ERROR required.

mutants.name: M1-drop-missing-key-arm
mutants.why: Removing the gate check entirely re-opens the defect: a validation: line missing propagation_check= (the diagnostic-100032 defect) silently reaches BAR_MET. Test 1 expects CONTINUE; without the gate it gets BAR_MET.

mutants.name: M2-drop-no-stanza-guard
mutants.why: Returning an empty frozenset instead of None when no stanza is found causes the gate to fire on every plan without a manifest (empty set ⊄ MANIFEST_VALIDATION_KEYS). Test 3 expects BAR_MET on a no-stanza plan; this mutant makes it return CONTINUE.

mutants.name: M3-compare-values-not-keys
mutants.why: Extracting the value portion (split('=')[1]) instead of the key portion (split('=')[0]) causes the gate to compare MANIFEST_VALIDATION_KEYS against the stored VALUES ('BAR_MET', '0_FAIL', …), which never match key names — gate always fires. Test 4 expects BAR_MET with stale values; this mutant makes it return CONTINUE.

mutants.name: M4-hardcode-key-list
mutants.why: Inlining the key set instead of reading MANIFEST_VALIDATION_KEYS breaks the anti-drift coupling: patch.object(cycle_check, 'MANIFEST_VALIDATION_KEYS', augmented) no longer affects the gate. Test 5 patches the constant to add 'extra_key' and expects CONTINUE; this mutant lets BAR_MET through because the hardcoded set lacks 'extra_key'.
mutants.anchor: if stored is not None and not MANIFEST_VALIDATION_KEYS.issubset(stored):
mutants.replacement: if stored is not None and not frozenset({"cycle_check", "plan_lint", "fold_check", "propagation_check"}).issubset(stored):
